readings.label: Floor directory
readings.title: Floor directory
readings.text: Rooms on this floor are numbered from the stairs. If the numbers do not run in order, return to the stairs and count again. Do not knock on doors whose numbers you did not count.

readings.label: Housekeeping card
readings.title: Housekeeping
readings.text: Linen is changed while guests are out. Guests are asked to be out between eleven and four. Staff will not answer a door that is answered from inside.

readings.label: Fire notice
readings.title: In case of fire
readings.text: Leave by the nearest stair. The service passage is for staff and is latched from the far side for your safety. Do not wait for the lift. The lift is not coming.

readings.label: Night porter's notice
readings.title: Night porter
readings.text: The night porter makes his round on every floor at every hour. Should you meet him in the corridor, stand aside and do not ask him the time.

readings.label: Lost property slip
readings.title: Lost property
readings.text: Items left in rooms are kept for thirty days. Items left in corridors are kept by the corridor. Please enquire at the desk, which is on another floor.

readings.label: Quiet hours notice
readings.title: Quiet hours
readings.text: Quiet hours are observed on this floor at all hours. Guests who hear music from the lounge are asked to keep walking until it stops.
